project_type: Cloudflare Pages static site — all HTML/CSS/JS, no PHP execution. PHP files exist in repo but are ignored by CF Pages.
language: HTML + vanilla JavaScript (ES6 modules via IIFE pattern), CSS (Tailwind CDN + custom)
build_system: None — Cloudflare Pages serves static files directly. No npm, no build step, no compilation. Deploy by git push to main branch.
test_framework: None — static site. Verification is manual browser testing: open file, check resources load (HTTP 200), check JS behavior.
test_command: None (no automated tests). Manual: open pages in browser, check DevTools Network tab for 404s.
verification_instructions: 1. Open each modified HTML file in a browser (or via local server). 2. Check DevTools Network tab: all assets (CSS, JS, images) return 200. 3. Check all nav links point to correct new paths. 4. For dashboards: clear localStorage/sessionStorage, reload — should redirect to ../../auth/login.html. 5. For error pages: open each and visually verify layout. 6. For security.js: open console and verify BGNSecurity is defined; test DevTools detection by opening DevTools.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace. Cloudflare Pages: PHP does NOT run. Workers must be deployed separately with wrangler CLI (not part of Pages deploy). The _redirects file is the CF Pages redirect/rewrite mechanism — rules are applied top-to-bottom, catch-all must be last. Leaflet map CDN is loaded via unpkg CDN (absolute URL). Video background from Cloudinary (absolute URL).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Git branch: work on current branch (main). Do not push. Commit locally after each FEAT.
key_patterns: 1. All pages use Tailwind CDN (no PostCSS build). 2. Color palette: primary=#001026, secondary=#395f95, tertiary-fixed=#6ffbbe, surface=#f8f9ff. 3. Font: Plus Jakarta Sans from Google Fonts. 4. Session stored as JSON in localStorage AND sessionStorage under key 'mbg_session' with shape {name, role, exp}. 5. Dashboard auth guard is an inline <script> that reads session, falls back to fetch('../../api/auth_user.php'), redirects to login on failure. 6. All JS modules use IIFE pattern exposing globals (window.BGNSecurity, window.BGNApi). 7. Error pages: existing root 404.html uses assets/css/style.css and Tailwind CDN — new error/ pages should mirror this pattern but with ../assets/ prefix.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (landing page), login.html (auth page — to move to auth/), _redirects (CF Pages redirects), 5 fitur HTML files at root (to move to fitur/), 404.html (existing error page). auth/: login.php + logout.php (PHP, unused — delete). dashboard/: admin/index.html, sppg/index.html, user/index.html (three role dashboards). assets/: css/ (style.css, dashboard.css, security.css, theme.css), js/ (api.js, script.js, security.js, live_chat.js), images/ (logo.webp, favicon.webp, placeholders). api/: PHP backend files (unused on CF Pages). database/: SQL schemas and PHP DB scripts. workers/: TO CREATE — Cloudflare Workers JS files. fitur/: TO CREATE — moved HTML feature pages. error/: TO CREATE — styled error pages.
